description: Altyst is a browser-based real estate underwriting platform that generates complete investment models from deal documents. The financial math itself is deterministic rather than AI-generated: the platform builds pro forma operating models (gross rent, vacancy, expenses, NOI), sizes debt by LTV, DSCR, and debt yield constraints, models lease rollovers with tenant improvement costs, and runs base, upside, and downside scenarios with sensitivity grids. All inputs remain editable with the full model recomputing live, and outputs export as Excel workbooks with live formulas, PDF memos, and editable PowerPoint decks. Supported property types include multifamily, office, retail, industrial, self-storage, mixed-use, hospitality, and land development.

Its analytics layer includes the ATTOM AVM, a rental AVM, comparable sales, market and location analytics, and property risk models for natural disasters and default propensity. Data is delivered through a property data API, bulk file licensing, and cloud-native channels including Snowflake and Databricks, with MCP server support and the ATTOM Nexus data discovery platform. Customers include real estate portals, institutional investors, brokerages, mortgage companies, insurers, government agencies, and technology platforms.

Accounting tools include a real estate-specific chart of accounts, tax preparation support, document storage, and role-based team access for collaborators and accountants. The platform supports single-family, multifamily, commercial, and short- to long-term rentals, and monetizes through payment processing, screening fees, and optional services rather than subscriptions. AI-powered bookkeeping auto-tags transactions by property, entity, and tax category, feeding cash flow insights and an instant tax package of ledgers, receipts, and statements. Rent collection supports automated invoicing, reminders, and online payments for rent and deposits, alongside bill pay, tenant screening, landlord insurance, and rental property loans. It targets solo landlords through investors with long-term, mid-term, and short-term rental portfolios.

A performance dashboard called Vitals gives leaders visibility into business results. Inside Real Estate positions itself as a technology partner for growing real estate brands, with customers including NextHome, Weichert, and REC Canada. Modules cover financial analysis, market intelligence (real-time comps, tax data, and insurance calculations), site selection supply-demand analysis, and an agent builder for automated sourcing and underwriting workflows. It focuses on multifamily and self-storage with support for additional asset classes on higher tiers, and every plan includes unlimited users. Pricing is quote-based across Core, Plus, and Max tiers, with a 7-day free trial.

title: Condo Control

description: Condo Control is a cloud-based property management platform for condominiums, HOAs, co-ops, and community associations that consolidates accounting, operations, resident services, payments, and governance into one connected system. Financial tools cover billing, collections, payables, receivables, bank reconciliation, budgeting, and audit-ready reporting, while operations features track maintenance requests, tasks, architectural approvals, and preventive maintenance. Residents get a self-service portal for payments, requests, amenity booking, document access, and voting, and governance tools handle e-voting, proxy voting, meeting agendas, and audit trails. Communication features include announcements, discussion forums, virtual meetings, surveys, and branded community websites, with AI-powered communications and financial summaries layered on top. It scales from single communities to multi-property portfolios.

title: Corefact
headline: Real estate direct mail and farming platform where every mailer is trackable.
description: Corefact is a direct mail marketing platform for real estate agents and brokers that combines a design library of postcards, mailers, flyers, brochures, business cards, and yard signs with print fulfillment and campaign management. Mailers carry QR codes and unique URLs so agents can track engagement and capture seller leads, feeding a built-in leads dashboard, contacts manager, and listing manager. The Corefact Elite service runs automated, set-and-forget monthly farming campaigns, and the platform supports Every Door Direct Mail and USPS Informed Delivery for digital exposure alongside physical mail. It is used by agents at major brokerages including Century 21, Keller Williams, RE/MAX, and Compass.

title: CREBuilder
headline: Create offering memorandums and market CRE listings from one property record.
description: CREBuilder is software for creating commercial real estate marketing materials and managing the sales and leasing process from a single property record. Users build offering memorandums from property data - with auto-populated tax data, maps, demographics, rent rolls, pro formas, and cap rate analysis - then generate sales teasers, leasing packages, flyers, and broker opinions of value from the same information. Distribution tools include email blasts, Instagram and Facebook posts, PDF export, and branded property websites on custom listing subdomains. A built-in CRM captures contacts, tracks activity, and manages deal pipelines, while NDA-gated deal rooms with access tiers and e-signing handle confidential sharing. It is aimed at CRE brokers and their teams, from independent shops to agents at national firms.

title: CREOP
headline: Cloud platform for building branded offering memorandums and CRE marketing.
description: CREOP is a cloud-based commercial real estate marketing platform where users enter property data and upload images to generate offering memorandums, flyers, broker opinions of value, proposals, and property websites. The system automatically produces financial analyses such as income/expense, rent roll, cash flow projections, and IRR sensitivity, along with charts and ESRI-powered demographics with customizable radii. Materials can include aerial maps, site plans, floor plans, and stacking plans, and are output as company-branded PDFs, flipbooks, and property websites with embedded video support. It also offers ChatGPT integration for property descriptions plus deal rooms and escrow rooms for sharing documents. CREOP supports retail, office, land, multifamily, self-storage, industrial, hospitality, mixed-use, and net-lease property types, among others.

title: Curb Hero
headline: Free QR-code open house sign-in that sends every visitor to your CRM.
description: Curb Hero is a digital open house sign-in app that replaces paper sheets with QR-code visitor capture. Sign-in pages use branded, customizable templates, work offline, and push leads to more than 2,000 CRMs through direct integrations and Zapier. Beyond sign-in, the product generates listing microsites optimized for social sharing, reusable dynamic QR codes for marketing materials, lead verification that appends background information, and digital disclosures and waivers. Solo agents use it free, with premium plans adding team and brokerage coordination, and lenders and builders use it for co-branded sign-in.

title: DataMaster
headline: Pulls MLS and public-record data straight into appraisal reports.
description: DataMaster, a Class Valuation product, automates data collection and market analysis for real estate appraisal reports. It pulls MLS data, public records, and comparable property information directly into an appraiser's report software, with Smart Field Technology handling data input and CompTracker maintaining a personal comparables database. Analysis tools cover market conditions and neighborhood analysis, automated 1004MC form population, and adjustment calculations, with workfile documentation for consistency. The company claims it saves appraisers over 60 minutes per report. Single-user unlimited pricing is published at $89/month, with Express and Pro versions and multi-user or annual pricing by inquiry.

headline: Find, underwrite, and report on investment deals in one AI workspace.
description: DealWorthIt is cloud software that combines deal sourcing, underwriting, and reporting for real estate investors. Deal Finder searches on-market and off-market properties across more than 150 million records with 50+ filters, while the analysis module underwrites multifamily, self-storage, single-family, and new-construction deals with T12 and rent roll import. Market data includes rent comps, demographics, employment data, and live rate feeds, and results export as customizable, investor-ready PDF reports. It serves investors, syndicators, acquisition teams, brokers, and investor communities from newcomers to experienced professionals. Plans are published at $79, $149, and $299 per month, differing by monthly analysis volume and team seats.

title: Delta Media Group

description: Delta Media Group develops DeltaNET, an all-in-one, AI-powered CRM and digital marketing platform sold to residential real estate brokerages, franchise networks, teams, and agents. DeltaNET combines brokerage and agent websites with SEO tooling, a CRM, email and social marketing automation, advertising, analytics, and the Delta Academy training system in a single integrated platform. The current DeltaNET 7 release emphasizes customization, letting each brokerage configure its own branding and feature set so its platform differs from competitors using the same vendor. Companion tools include Social Connector for agent social media automation, Local Showings, and Properties in Motion. Delta Media is a family-owned company that has operated for roughly three decades and offers customers a written no-sell guarantee.

title: ManageCasa

Accounting includes a per-property general ledger, trust accounting with separate fund tracking, automated bank reconciliation, AP/AR, and budget-versus-actual reporting, alongside online rent and dues collection with ACH and card processing. Association-specific tools cover violations, architectural review workflows, eVoting, board packets, and homeowner portals, while rental workflows add listing syndication, screening integration, digital leases, and eSignature. A Minii AI assistant handles task automation, document search, and around-the-clock Q&A. Published pricing starts at $45/month, with $0.50 per unit above 500 units, and the platform integrates with QuickBooks, Stripe, Plaid, Mailchimp, and Outlook.

title: MotionCRE
headline: Deal management workspace for commercial real estate teams.
description: MotionCRE is deal management software for commercial real estate teams that replaces spreadsheets, shared drives, and email threads with a single workspace per deal. A real-time pipeline offers drag-and-drop stage management with days-in-stage tracking and filtering by asset class, market, or assignee, while each deal workspace centralizes files, contacts, tasks, key dates, financing quotes, and notes.
